prompt: Create a production-ready isolated 2D game scenery sprite of a Bluey Tradies inspired backyard fish pond for a private family playset. TRANSPARENT background. Wide landscape canvas approximately 1536x768. Charming clean Bluey television background art: simple softly shaded painted shapes, gentle muted pastel colors, subtle dark blue-gray outlines, not 3D, not photorealistic. The pond is an irregular wide low oval made of large smooth beige/light-gray stones, with clear quiet blue-green water. On its BACK CENTER rim, one small stack of two natural rocks with a short narrow waterfall trickling into the pond. Small fern leaves, low garden greenery and a few pink flowers clustered ONLY behind and beside the rocks. The water opening is a VERY SIMPLE broad flat oval centered horizontally, about 65 percent of canvas width and 20 percent of canvas height; its center should be at about 56 percent down the canvas. Water is flat pale teal with minimal highlights, NO FISH, NO FOOD, NO painted ripples; fish and moving ripples will be drawn separately by the game. The rear rock ledge and waterfall above the opening, front stone lip just beneath the opening, clear plain grass shore as a low wide band at the bottom to conceal older painted scenery. Whole object fully visible with generous transparent margin. Side-on slightly elevated view consistent with Bluey's 2D backyard background perspective. Keep pond low and inviting and leave front shore free for four children. No characters, no rods, no bridges, no lantern, no text, no UI, no background scenery. Single isolated integrated pond sprite, actual transparent alpha.

Edit this exact panorama for a layered 2D game. Keep its same 3:1 wide framing, tree positions, fruit tree and stump at left, big tree at right, fence, sky, distant houses, all surrounding bushes, and foreground grass. ONLY remove the small painted fish pond, its rim stones, lilies, water and stone lantern in the rear garden to the right of center underneath the large tree. Reconstruct that small cleared area as continuous grass meeting the existing fence-side low foliage, with ordinary garden plants behind it. There must be NO pond, water, stone border, lantern or depression remaining in that cleared area. This is the clean background beneath a separate animated pond sprite that will be placed by game code. Preserve original perspective and softly painted Bluey-like background style and all other scenery. Do not move or change any tree or make any new structure. Preserve the foreground walkable grass.

Create a polished 2D game sprite atlas of EIGHT BEAUTIFUL small ornamental pond fish for a Bluey-style family fishing game. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. WIDE landscape canvas, approximately 1800x900. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of EQUAL CELLS, with ONE isolated fish centered in each of the eight cells. All fish swim to the RIGHT, side/profile view, whole body and delicate tail/fins visible, NO WATER, no shadow, no environment, no bubbles, no text, no cell borders. Each fish occupies about 75 percent of its cell width and about 45 percent of its cell height, so there is generous transparent space above and below for clean sprite cropping. Eight separate attractive designs: top row 1 flowing orange-and-gold goldfish, 2 elegant ivory-white koi with coral-orange patches, 3 sunshine-yellow pond fish with golden flowing fins, 4 white-and-charcoal koi with a red head patch. Bottom row 1 soft peach-and-cream fancy goldfish with rounded double tail, 2 warm orange koi with pearl-white patches, 3 buttery cream pond fish with delicate amber fins, 4 pearl-white koi with little slate-blue and orange markings. Style: the charming hand-painted clean 2D animation of Bluey backgrounds, soft colored outlines, subtle smooth shading and fin details, beautiful graceful curved tails and small kind expressive eyes. Sophisticated pretty illustrations, still friendly for small children, not crude geometric shapes, not clip-art, not photorealistic, not 3D, no enormous googly eyes, no scary teeth. All eight fish should be similarly sized with consistent quality and lighting. Exact regular 4x2 grid, eight fish only, actual transparent alpha.
